record.label: Direct fifth-order diag/two-index exact carry
record.summary: Closed only for the implemented direct fifth-order spelling. The diag, K41, and K32 push chains verify to <=3.776008120484528e-16, yet adding them autonomously is violently unstable across both n=16, depth-5, 20M-antithetic-MC seeds: C -> D MSE is 0.0019371902666675653 -> 0.11720815944570878 and 0.0889081513905304 -> 644.8317168674707; the kappa6-free E spelling is worse again at 92.51253102041694 and 73436.32971540386. One-step teacher forcing can improve, so this is an autonomous partial-state instability result, not a proof that all higher-order carry is useless. The advertised T5 width-power and T6 n=1024 cost sections were not implemented in the receipt and are not claimed here.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed by two-seed autonomous small-n failure with exact chain and connected-assembly verification.
